note: The lower half of the same printed page, closer in - so large, clean type - but photographed with the tablet held sideways: the page is stored rotated 90 degrees and carries no EXIF orientation tag to say so. That makes it the orientation test. Tesseract's OSD reads it correctly ('Orientation in degrees: 90, Rotate: 270'). The 'entre ... et' row at the top edge is deliberately not in the truth: its German half is cut off by the frame, so no reader could return it.
